name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by his grandfather's tales of working on classic British racing cars. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in materials science, before landing an apprenticeship at a small racing team, honing his fabrication skills. After several years of dedicated work, he impressed the right people with his meticulous approach to precision engineering and a knack for finding innovative solutions under pressure, earning him a spot at Toyota Gazoo Racing.

Alistair thrives on challenges and is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection. He believes that every component, no matter how small, can be optimized for performance, and he's not afraid to push the boundaries of material science. His demanding nature stems from his unwavering commitment to excellence and a desire to see the team achieve its full potential. He is a valued member of the team, known for his creative solutions and commitment to quality.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight side part.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a lean build honed from years of physical work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needle point before starting work.
Refuses to use power tools if hand tools will suffice.
Has a specific playlist of classic rock he listens to while working.
